detail.title: 16 MP Multi-Sensor 360° Panoramic PTZ Mini Hubble WizMind Network Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite PSDW81652S-A360-D440 16 MP Multi-Sensor 360° Panoramic PTZ Mini Hubble WizMind Network Camera Key Points • Panoramic Channel: 16 MP Ultra-High-Definition Resolution • Panoramic Channel: 8 × 2 MP, 1/1.8" CMOS Image Sensors • Panoramic Channel: Field of View: H: 360°; V: 103° • PTZ Channel: 4 MP Resolution, 40x Optical Zoom,16x Digital Zoom • PTZ Channel: Support GIS and Optical Defog, Enhancing Image Quality in Complex Situations • Xinghan Vision Models-Crowd Map: Enhances Crowd Statistics Accuracy by Day/Night, and in Rain • Smart Tracking: Quickly and Automatically Tracks Moving Targets and Delivers Rich Details • Built-in Dual Mic & Dual Speaker: Secure Real-Time Talk • AR Panorama Technology, Various AR Tags Can be Overlaid • 36 VDC or PoE ++(802.3bt) power supply • IP67, IK10 and Anti-Corrosion Design (NEMA 4X, optional) for Reliable Protection Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.Min. Illumination: Channel 1 (Panoramic): 0.0005 lux@F1.0 (Color, 30 IRE) 0.0001 lux@F1.0 (B/W, 30 IRE) Channel 2 (PTZ): 0.001 lux@F1.6 (Color, 30 IRE) 0.0001 lux @F1.6 (B/W, 30 IRE) 0 lux (Illuminator on)
General.Illumination Distance: Channel 1 (Panoramic): NA Channel 2 (PTZ): Up to 150 m (492.13 ft)(IR); Up to 100 m (328.09 ft)(Warm light)
General.Angle Adjustment: Pan: 0° to 360° ; Tilt: –10° to 180°, auto flip 180°
General.Close Focus Distance: Channel 1 (Panoramic): 1.4 m (4.59 ft) Channel 2 (PTZ): 0.5 m (1.64 ft)
General.Intelligence Notes: Channel 1 (Panoramic): Perimeter protection, crowd map (Large-Scale AI Models), vehicle density, boat detection. Channel 2 (PTZ): Perimeter protection, video metadata, face detection.
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Channel 1 (Panoramic): Tripwire; intrusion; parking detection Channel 2 (PTZ): Tripwire; intrusion; parking detection; crossing virtual fence; fast moving; abandoned object; missing object; crowd gathering; loitering detection
General.Face Detection: Channel 1 (Panoramic): NA Channel 2 (PTZ): Face detection; snapshot; snapshot optimization; optimal face snapshot upload; face enhancement; face exposure; face attributes extraction including 6 attributes and 8 expressions; face snapshot set as face or one-inch photo; snapshot strategies (real-time snapshot, quality priority and optimization snapshot); face angle filter; optimization time setting.
General.Vehicle Density: Channel 1 (Panoramic): Vehicle density; parking upper limit; traffic congestion; vehicle status alarm Channel 2 (PTZ): NA
General.Crowd Distribution Map: Channel 1 (Panoramic): Crowd map (Large-Scale AI Models), global crowd density; crowd density in area; people counting in area; crowd status Channel 2 (PTZ): NA
General.Video Metadata: Channel 1 (Panoramic): NA Channel 2 (PTZ): Motor vehicle, non-motor vehicle, face, and human body detection; snapshot; snapshot optimization; optimal face snapshot upload. Extraction of motor vehicle and non-motor vehicle attributes: extracts 6 attributes for motor vehicle and 6 attributes for non-motor vehicle Extraction of face and human body attributes: extracts 6 attributes for face and 8 attributes for human body.
General.Smart Search: Work together with Smart NVR to perform refine intelligent search, event extraction and merging to event videos.
General.Video Compression: H.265; H.264; H.264H; H.264B; MJPEG (Only supported by the sub stream)
General.Video Frame Rate: Channel 1 (Panoramic): Main stream: 8192 × 1800@(1–25/30 fps) sub stream: 2048 × 452@(1–25/30 fps) third stream: 3840 × 832@(1–25/30 fps) Channel 2 (PTZ): Main stream: 2688 × 1520@(1–25/30 fps) sub stream: 704 × 480@(1–25/30 fps) third stream: 1920 × 1080@(1–25/30 fps) *The values above are the max. frame rates of each stream; for multiple streams, the values will be subjected to the total encoding capacity.
General.Video Bit Rate: Channel 1 (Panoramic): H.264: 96 kbps–32768 kbps H.265: 38 kbps–25692 kbps Channel 2 (PTZ): H.264: 32 kbps–16384 kbps H.265: 12 kbps–11008 kbps
General.White Balance: Auto; natural; street lamp; outdoor; manual; regional custom
General.Region of Interest (RoI): Channel 1 (Panoramic): Yes (4 areas) Channel 2 (PTZ): Yes (8 areas)
General.Image Stabilization: Channel 1 (Panoramic): NA Channel 2 (PTZ): Gyroscope Image Stabilization (GIS)
General.Privacy Masking: Channel 1 (Panoramic): 4 areas (rectangle) Channel 2 (PTZ): 24 areas (8 for each preset) (polygon)
General.Audio Compression: PCM; G.711a; G.711Mu; G.726; G.723, G.711a by default
General.Alarm Event: Channel 1 (Panoramic): External alarm; No SD card; SD card full; SD card error; network disconnection; IP conflict; illegal access; voltage detection; motion detection; video tampering; scene changing; audio detection; intensity change; tripwire; intrusion; parking detection; crowd density; traffic congestion; parking upper limit; Channel 2 (PTZ): Tripwire; intrusion; parking detection; crossing virtual fence; fast moving; abandoned object; missing object; crowd gathering; loitering detection; face detection; video metadata
General.Network Protocol: IPv4; IPv6; HTTP; TCP; UDP; ARP; RTP; RTSP; RTCP; RTMP; SMTP; FTP; SFTP; DHCP; DNS; DDNS; QoS; UPnP; NTP; Multicast; ICMP; IGMP; NFS; SAMBA; PPPoE; SNMP; P2P
General.Security: WSSE; Account lockout; Trusted execution; Generation and importing of X.509 certification; 802.1x; Security logs; Digest; IP/MAC filtering; HTTPS; Trusted upgrade; syslog;Trusted boot
General.Storage: FTP; SFTP; Micro SD card (support max. 1 TB); NAS; SMB
General.Pan/Tilt Range: Pan: 0° to 360° endless Tilt: –10° to 180°, auto flip 180°
General.Certifications: CE-LVD: EN62368-1; CE-EMC: Electromagnetic Compatibility Directive 2014/30/EU
General.Alarm Input: 3 channels in: wet contact, 5 mA 3–5 VDC
General.Alarm Output: 2 channels out: dry contact, 1,000 mA 30 VDC/500 mA 50 VAC
General.Power Output: 12 VDC power output, max. current 165 mA, peak current 700 mA
General.Power Consumption: Basic: 26.4 W (36 VDC); Max.: 67.8 W (36 VDC) (Basic power consumption + WDR + intelligence on +Speaker+Heater+ LED on + PTZ operation)
